definitions.full: H8100. Shimath שִׁמְעָת proper name, feminine 2Chr 24:26 mother of one of Joash's murderers , 2 Kings 12 :22 ( Ιεμουαθ ), called Ammonitess 24:26 ( Σαμα ( αθ )).

occurrences.englishText: These are those who conspired against him: Zabad the son of Shimeath the Ammonitess and Jehozabad the son of Shimrith the Moabitess.
